pixel_convention: x to the right, y downward, pixel centres at integer coordinates

camera.motion: static (uniform grey background with faint fixed texture; no shift seen; background differencing against a fixed frame leaves no residue)
camera.perspective: none visible: side (profile) views of both objects, no ground plane, no horizon; treated as one image plane
camera.scale_consistency_check: plane length / car length in px = 750.5 / 113.5 = 6.61 (an A320 ~37.6 m over a Cybertruck ~5.7 m is ~6.6), consistent with both objects at the same depth - sanity only, not a scale

objects.name: plane
objects.description: white Air China airliner (A320-family look), red phoenix logo on the tail fin, side view facing right, upper part of the frame
objects.motion: translates horizontally to the RIGHT at constant pixel speed (~50.5 px/frame), y constant; leaves the frame through the right edge
objects.visible_frames: 0-25 (fully visible 0-10; truncated by the right image edge 11-25; gone from 26)

full_size_px.note: mean over fully visible frames 0-10 (range 749-753); length includes horizontal-stabiliser tip at left and nose at right

objects.reference_point: bbox centre in frames 0-10; frames 11-25 = tail (left) edge x0 + 374.77 px, y = 397.09 (constant mean of frames 0-10)

objects.name: car
objects.description: silver/white angular pickup (Tesla Cybertruck look), side view, below the plane at y ~585-622
objects.motion: drives horizontally to the LEFT, starting from rest (frames 0 and 1 identical) and speeding up steadily (per-frame step grows ~0.35-0.4 px/frame each frame, ~14 px/frame by frame 40); y constant

full_size_px.note: length 113-114 px while slow (frames 0-20); grows to 117 px by frame 40 from motion blur; height jitters 35/38 px because the low-contrast roof edge sits at the threshold

static_objects: none - background is a plain uniform grey (no ground, markings or props)

events.event: frames 0 and 1 are identical for both objects (motion starts after frame 1)
plane and car both begin moving (first nonzero displacement between frames 1 and 2)
plane nose reaches the right image edge (last fully visible frame 10)
plane last visible (only tail tip, 16 px)
car still accelerating leftward at end of clip; no stops, bounces, contacts or direction changes
